## ReconciliationCaseWorkflowVocabulary

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.Strategies.Services.ReconciliationCaseWorkflowVocabulary</code>. Kind: `class`.

Source: [src/Meridian.Strategies/Services/ReconciliationCaseWorkflowVocabulary.cs:19](../../../../src/Meridian.Strategies/Services/ReconciliationCaseWorkflowVocabulary.cs#L19).

Compile-time-checked translation between the C# reconciliation enums and the string token vocabulary of the F# ReconciliationCaseWorkflow. The F# kernel is a leaf assembly and cannot reference these enums, so the previous boundary relied on coincidental name equality (enum.ToString() / Enum.Parse): an enum rename or addition silently misrouted a transition at runtime. Every mapping below references its enum member by name (via nameof), so renaming a member breaks compilation here, and the exhaustive _ =&gt; throw arms surface any newly added member immediately instead of silently falling through the workflow. The ReconciliationCaseWorkflowVocabularyTests guard additionally asserts token parity against the vocabulary the F# workflow actually recognizes.


## SecurityFactorObservation

Source: [src/Meridian.Strategies/Services/SecurityMasterAccountingEventService.cs:132](../../../../src/Meridian.Strategies/Services/SecurityMasterAccountingEventService.cs#L132).

One reconciliation-period factor OBSERVATION for a factor-based security: the prior→current factor pair with its source and evidence lineage, as expected paydown generation consumes it. This is deliberately NOT a factor-schedule term shape — the canonical dated factor schedule is Meridian.FSharp.Domain.FactorScheduleEntry on StructuredCreditTerms (declared as factorScheduleEntries and read by StructuredCashFlowTermsResolver); the source adapter derives these observations FROM that canonical schedule, pairing each factor with its ordered predecessor and attaching provenance/evidence. Formerly named SecurityFactorScheduleEntry, which misread as a third, incompatible schedule shape.

```csharp
public sealed record SecurityFactorObservation(Guid SecurityId, DateOnly AsOfDate, decimal PriorFactor, decimal CurrentFactor, string Source, string? EvidenceLink = null, string? SourceContentHash = null);
```
